uncovered_shapes.sentence: Analysts noted the high cadence across multiple providers.

claims.claim: SpaceX confirmed plans to catch both the Super Heavy booster and Starship upper stage on Flight 15.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX confirmed plans to catch the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage with the launch tower arms on Flight 15, expected next month.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Starship on Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX will try to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage with the launch tower on Flight 15, expected next month.

claims.claim: An 80-second animation showed the upper stage completing its belly-flop reentry and being secured by tower arms.
claims.episode_span: An 80-second animation shown during the earnings webcast depicted the upper stage completing its belly-flop reentry, steering with forward and aft flaps, swinging vertical, and being secured by the tower arms after dropping past the tower top.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Starship on Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX played an animation of about 80 seconds on Tuesday’s earnings webcast showing a Starship upper stage caught by the tower’s chopstick arms.

claims.claim: Elon Musk rated the first catch attempt more likely than not to succeed.
claims.episode_span: Elon Musk rated the first attempt more likely than not to succeed and noted that SpaceX maintains a steady stream of Starship flights through year-end if the initial try fails.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Starship on Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: Musk said success would be the first time an orbital launch vehicle has been fully recovered. He rated the first attempt “more likely than not” to work.

claims.claim: SpaceX delivered $14.6 billion in Q3 revenue, up 161 percent year-over-year.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX delivered $14.6 billion in revenue for the third quarter, a 161 percent increase from the prior year, and added $6.7 billion in incremental Super Intelligence solutions and infrastructure revenue.
claims.supporting_quote: Delivered revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year

claims.claim: Nameplate compute capacity reached 1.7 GW as of September 30, 2026.
claims.episode_span: Nameplate compute capacity reached 1.7 GW as of September 30.
claims.supporting_quote: Continued to scale nameplate compute, reaching 1.7 GW as of September 30, 2026

claims.claim: SpaceX and Tesla each formed special committees of independent directors to study a merger.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX and Tesla each established special committees of independent directors to examine a potential merger.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Starship on Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: Elon Musk confirmed the plan on the company’s third quarter earnings call on Tuesday. He also said Tesla and SpaceX have each formed special committees of independent directors to study a merger.

claims.claim: The Vandenberg Starlink launch using booster B1063 on its 36th flight was scrubbed on October 20.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX scrubbed the planned launch of 27 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on October 20 after a technical issue. The mission, using booster B1063 on its 36th flight, is now targeted for a window opening at 2:59 p.m. PDT on October 21.
claims.source_title: SpaceX scrubs launch of 27 Starlink satellites on Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg SFB
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX was set to launch a batch of 27 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California Tuesday afternoon, but ran into what appears to have been a technical issue that wasn’t surmountable during their launch window.

claims.claim: SpaceX spent roughly $1 billion on Starship development in Q3 2026.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX spent roughly $1 billion on Starship development in the third quarter while reporting its first solidly profitable quarter as a public company.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Spent $1B on Starship in Q3 2026
claims.supporting_quote: From its financial documents for 3Q 2026, it appears that SpaceX spent about $1 billion on Starship development during the last three months.
